channel.title: Wander Blog
channel.description: Practical guides from the Wander team: testing location features in Xcode and Android, fixing setup problems, sideloading explained, and location privacy.

item.title: Apple Verification Code Not Showing Up? How to Get One on iOS 18 and iOS 26
item.description: No Apple verification code on your trusted iPhone? On iOS 18 and iOS 26, Get Verification Code only appears offline. Step-by-step fix, plus the text or call option.

item.title: Does GPS Work in Airplane Mode or Without Data? What Your Phone Can Still Do Offline
item.description: Phone GPS usually keeps working in airplane mode and without mobile data, but your map may not. What Apple and Google say, the limits, and a quick test.

item.title: How Your Phone Knows Where You Are, With or Without GPS
item.description: How your phone finds you with or without GPS: how satellites, Wi-Fi, cell towers and sensors combine, how accurate they can be, and which settings matter.

item.title: GPX vs KML vs GeoJSON: What Each Route File Stores and Which One Your Tool Needs
item.description: GPX, KML and GeoJSON all store points and paths, but not the same details. What each keeps, the coordinate-order trap, and which file your tool can read.

item.title: How to Set a Location in the Android Emulator (and Fix It When It Won't Update)
item.description: Set a single point, play a route or load a GPX or KML file in the Android Emulator, then fix a blank map, a stuck blue dot or a geo fix that does nothing.

item.title: Xcode Simulate Location Not Working? How to Fix It in the Simulator and on a Real iPhone
item.description: Xcode's Simulate Location greyed out, your GPX file missing, or the iPhone snapping back when the debugger stops? Causes and fixes for Simulator and device.

item.title: How to Test Geofencing Without Driving Around: iOS and Android, From Simulator to Real Device
item.description: Test geofence enter, exit and dwell events without leaving your desk: start in the Simulator or emulator, then test on a real phone with the app in background.

item.title: 'Select Mock Location App' Not Showing or Not Working on Android: How to Fix It
item.description: Can't find Select mock location app, or your app isn't listed? Where Android 12 moved it, why apps go missing, and how to fix it without root.

item.title: iPhone Developer Mode Not Showing? Why the Toggle Is Missing and How to Make It Appear
item.description: Developer Mode missing from Privacy & Security on your iPhone? Why iOS hides the toggle, what makes it appear, and how to switch it off again when you're done.

item.title: Why Sideloaded iPhone Apps Expire After 7 Days (and the 3-App Limit), Explained
item.description: Apps installed with a free Apple ID stop opening after 7 days, and you can only keep 3. Apple's rules, how refreshing works, and how to recover an expired app.

item.title: Precise Location vs Approximate Location: What Apps Really Get, and When to Turn Precise Off
item.description: What precise and approximate location actually share on iPhone and Android, which apps truly need your exact spot, and how to change the setting app by app.

item.title: How to Set a Real iPhone's Location From a Windows PC: pymobiledevice3, GeoPort and Wander Desktop Compared
item.description: No Mac or Xcode? Three tools built for Apple's iOS 17+ developer tunnel set a real iPhone's location from Windows: pymobiledevice3, GeoPort and Wander Desktop.

item.title: How to Get Your Real Location Back After a Mock or Simulated Location (iPhone and Android)
item.description: Phone still showing a simulated or mock location after you stopped? Step-by-step fixes for iPhone and Android, from switching location off and on to a full Location & Privacy reset.
